title: libcuflynx obs_data file (<name>_obs_data.json)
description: The data a calibration is scored against, its protocol, and the outputs to predict: an object with protocol_info (required), data_items and prediction_items, and an optional obs_data_name. Other top-level keys are ignored. Read by ObsAndParamDataParser.parse_obs_data_json (libcuflynx/parsers/PrimitiveParsers.py); vocabularies in libcuflynx/utilities/obs_data_helpers.py. The parser fills the defaults given here and refuses unknown keys in items and protocol_info.

obs_data_name.description: The name of this obs_data set. In a module library, parameterisations/<name>/<name>_obs_data.json must set it to <name> (a different or missing name is warned about). Default: none.

data_items.description: The observations a model is scored against. Default: none (a protocol-only file).

prediction_items.description: Outputs to record and plot, not scored in the calibration; with a value they are held-out validation data. Default: none.

prediction_plots.description: figures of a scalar feature against another feature or an input, across experiments (libcuflynx.param_id.prediction_plots); drawn by save_prediction_data and cuflynx-run-predictions

prediction_plot.description: one figure. A group is the data_items and prediction_items sharing an item_name_for_plotting, at most one per experiment; a point is one experiment

name.description: figure title and file stem; unique

kind.description: feature_vs_feature: y against another group; feature_vs_input: y against a value params_to_change sets

x.description: feature_vs_feature: a group; feature_vs_input: the number params_to_change sets in that sub-experiment

series.description: one line per distinct value of this input

params_to_change.description: the params_to_change key (a model parameter) whose value is used

subexperiment_idx.description: the sub-experiment whose value is used

dataItem.description: One observation the model is scored against. Unknown keys are refused. Checked by ObsAndParamDataParser.parse_obs_data_json (libcuflynx/parsers/PrimitiveParsers.py); it also checks what JSON Schema cannot: names unique across data_items and prediction_items, operation_kwargs references, a series std as long as its value, experiment indices in range.

data_item_name.description: Required. The item's identity: unique across every data_item and prediction_item of the file, and the name an operation_kwargs value naming another item resolves against. Need not be a model variable name.

data_type.description: Required. "constant": value and std are single numbers. "series": value is a list of samples obs_dt apart (from the start of the item's sub-experiment), std a number or a list as long as value. "frequency": value is a list of amplitudes at the item's frequencies. ("prob_dist" was removed: use "constant" with prob_dist_params.)

unit.description: Required. The unit of the observable (a CellML unit name).

operands.description: Required. The model variables ('component/variable') or earlier items the operation reduces, as a list. Empty strings are dropped. With no operation, the first operand is the observable itself.

operation.description: The operation function (built-in, funcs_user, or operation_funcs_external_path) reducing the operands to the observable. Default: none (null, "", "None", "null" and "nan" also mean none), in which case the first operand is used as it is.

operation_kwargs.description: Keyword arguments for the operation function. A string value naming another item (by data_item_name) is replaced by that item's value. Default: {}.

cost_type.description: The cost function (built-in or cost_funcs_external_path) scoring this item. Default: "gaussian_MLE".

cost_kwargs.description: Extra keyword arguments for the cost_type function; std and weight are supplied from the item's own keys and are refused here. Default: {}.

value.description: The ground truth: one number for a constant, a list for a series or frequency item. Required (with std) unless the item has prob_dist_params; a series item may instead load it from value_path.

std.description: The measurement standard deviation the cost normalises by: one number for a constant; for a series one number (applied to every sample) or one per sample, each finite and > 0. Required (with value) unless the item has prob_dist_params.

prob_dist_params.description: The ground truth as a distribution, for a cost_type that scores against one (kernel_density_estimation, multimodal_gaussian, poisson_MLE). An item with prob_dist_params needs no value or std. Default: none.

weight.description: The weight of this item in the cost (a list: one per sample or frequency). Default: 1.0.

obs_dt.description: The spacing of a series' samples, in seconds. Required for a series (filled from t_path when the series is loaded from .npy files).

experiment_idx.description: The experiment (index into protocol_info sim_times) the item is measured in. Default: 0.

subexperiment_idx.description: The sub-experiment of experiment_idx the item is measured over. Default: 0.

trace_name_for_plotting.description: Axis label (LaTeX allowed) of the trace the item is drawn from. May repeat across items. Default: the first operand, or data_item_name if there is none.

item_name_for_plotting.description: Label of the item itself, used in sensitivity tables and error reports. Default: "<trace_name_for_plotting> (<operation>)", or trace_name_for_plotting when there is no operation.

plot_type.description: How the ground truth is drawn: "horizontal", "vertical", "horizontal_from_min", "series" or "frequency" (null or "None" draws no marker). Default: "horizontal" for a constant, "series" for a series, "frequency" for a frequency item.

plot_color.description: Matplotlib colour of the item in plots. Default: cycles through b, g, c, m, y, tab:brown, tab:pink, tab:olive, tab:orange.

frequencies.description: The frequencies (Hz) of a frequency item's value. Default: none.

phase.description: The ground-truth phases of a frequency item, one per frequency. Default: none.

phase_weight.description: The weight of a frequency item's phase in the cost. Default: the item's weight.

t_path.description: A series' sample times as a .npy file (absolute, or relative to the working directory). Used with value_path instead of an embedded value; obs_dt defaults to their mean spacing.

value_path.description: A series' values as a .npy file, used with t_path instead of an embedded value (not both).

source.description: Where the data come from, as free text. Not read otherwise.

species.description: Metadata: the species the data are from. Not read.

location.description: Metadata: where the data were measured. Not read.

dt.description: Metadata. Accepted but not read (a series' spacing is obs_dt).

sample_rate.description: Metadata: a series' sample rate in Hz. Accepted but not read (a series' spacing is obs_dt).

allOf.description: A constant's value and std are single numbers.
A series' value is a list (embedded, or loaded from t_path and value_path, not both); it needs std, and obs_dt (or t_path to derive it from).
Every item needs a ground truth: value and std, or prob_dist_params.

predictionItem.description: A model output to record and plot, not scored in the calibration. It takes a data_item's vocabulary; with value (plus data_type, std, and obs_dt for a series) it is held-out data, checked after calibration (libcuflynx.param_id.validation, validation_results.json). Unknown keys are refused.

data_item_name.description: Required. The item's identity, unique across every data_item and prediction_item of the file.

operands.description: Required. The model variable(s) ('component/variable') to record.

unit.description: Required. The unit of the prediction.

operation.description: Reduces the operands to one number, as for a data_item: the item is then a scalar feature, its held-out value is compared with operation(operands), and sensitivity analysis and emulator training include it when include_prediction_items is true. Default: none.

operation_kwargs.description: Keyword arguments for the operation function; only with an operation. Default: {}.

experiment_idx.description: The experiment the operands are recorded in. Default: 0.

subexperiment_idx.description: The sub-experiment of experiment_idx the operands are recorded over. Default: the experiment's last sub-experiment.

trace_name_for_plotting.description: Axis label (LaTeX allowed) of the trace. Default: the first operand, or data_item_name if there is none.

item_name_for_plotting.description: Label of the item. Default: trace_name_for_plotting.

data_type.description: The shape of the held-out data: required with a value. Default: none (no held-out data).

value.description: Held-out data the prediction is validated against after calibration (never scored in the calibration): one number for a constant, a list for a series. Default: none.

std.description: The held-out data's standard deviation: one number for a constant; one number or one per sample for a series, each finite and > 0. Default: none.

obs_dt.description: The spacing of a held-out series' samples, in seconds; required for a series with a value. Default: none.

allOf.description: An item with a value needs data_type.
A held-out constant's value and std are single numbers.
A held-out series' value is a list of numbers, and it needs obs_dt.

protocolInfo.description: The simulation protocol: experiments, each a run of sub-experiments. Unknown keys are refused. pre_times and sim_times are required unless pre_time and sim_time are set in user_inputs.yaml (then one experiment of one sub-experiment). Checked by parse_obs_data_json, which also checks that params_to_change rows match sim_times and that every trace name it uses is defined.

pre_times.description: One per experiment: the time (s) simulated before it to reach steady state, not recorded. Default: [pre_time] from user_inputs.yaml.

sim_times.description: One list per experiment of its sub-experiment durations (s). Default: [[sim_time]] from user_inputs.yaml.

params_to_change.description: {model parameter qname: one row per experiment of one value per sub-experiment}. A string value names a protocol_traces or protocol_shapes entry (a time-varying input). Default: {}.

offline_pre_time.description: An unrecorded warm-up (s) run once before all experiments. Default: none.

experiment_labels.description: One label per experiment, for plots. Default: none.

experiment_ids.description: One identifier per experiment. Default: none.

experiment_colors.description: One matplotlib colour per experiment, for plots. Default: none.

t.description: Times (s) from the start of the sub-experiment.

values.description: The input's value at each time (interpolated linearly).

protocol_traces.description: {name: {t, values}}: time-varying inputs a params_to_change string names. Default: {}.

protocol_shapes.description: {name: shape}: the same inputs written as Myokit-style events or a ramp, expanded into protocol_traces on read. A name is defined in one of the two. Default: {}.

shape.description: A waveform written as Myokit-style events (type "pacing", the default) or a linear sweep (type "ramp"). A bare list is read as {"events": list}. Expanded into protocol_traces over the sub-experiment that uses it (libcuflynx/utilities/protocol_shapes.py).

type.description: "pacing" (square events) or "ramp" (from -> to across the sub-experiment). Default: "pacing".

events.description: Pacing: the events, one per line of a .mmt [[protocol]] table. Required for pacing.

baseline.description: Pacing: the value between events. Default: 0.

from.description: Ramp: the value at the start of the sub-experiment. Required for a ramp.

to.description: Ramp: the value at its end. Required for a ramp.

duration.description: The length of the generated trace. Default: the length of the sub-experiment(s) using the shape (required when they differ).

event.description: One line of a Myokit [[protocol]] table.

level.description: Required. The value during the event.

start.description: When the event first starts, from the start of the sub-experiment. Default: 0.

length.description: How long each occurrence lasts (Myokit's Length column). Give length or duration.

duration.description: Same as length (Myokit's Python API name). Give length or duration, not both.

period.description: Time between occurrences; 0 means it does not repeat. Default: 0.

multiplier.description: How many times the event occurs; 0 repeats it for the whole sub-experiment. More than 1 needs a period. Default: 0.
